answer.label: fine-tune bias
answer.justification: Only activation measurements are available, and they closely match the fine-tune bias fingerprint. Relative L2 runs 0.084 / 0.138 / 0.189 / 0.226 / 0.414 (reference 0.087 / 0.144 / 0.192 / 0.228 / 0.406). The onset is layer 13 (reference 13–14), and there is a large final-layer jump of +0.117 (reference +0.10). Direction consistency is 0.705 (reference 0.70), effective rank 3.12 (3.0), final cosine 0.906 (0.909) and mid-layer size ratio 1.021 (1.022). The size ratio above 1 rules out quantization and both system-prompt classes. The small layer-2 spike (0.1) and the low mid-depth difference (0.19 rather than about 0.4) also rule out the system-prompt classes. Fine-tune backdoor is ruled out by the late onset (13 rather than 3, so no early bump), the higher consistency (0.705 vs 0.62) and the larger final value and jump (0.414 / +0.117 vs 0.30 / +0.03).
